trials.claim: Plan 1 provides lifetime access to ElkQR
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to ElkQR
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Growth Plan updates
- Stack up to 3 codes
trials.reasoning: The review shows the product lasted and improved over years, but no exhibit directly proves lifetime access for Plan 1 buyers. The termination and paid-plan clauses are generic limits and do not directly show lifetime deal access was ended or charged for.

exhibits.quote: Upon termination, your access to the service will cease
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access ends permanently if the vendor terminates the account.

exhibits.quote: Account access is restricted until you choose a paid plan
exhibits.argument: Access can be restricted pending payment, contradicting guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: I bought into ElkQR via AppSumo and didn't expect much, but over the years the platform has remained and has continued, to my surprise, to upgrade and enhance itself.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the product has continued to upgrade and enhance over years, supporting the future updates element.

exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims responsibility for data loss, undermining unlimited stat retention.

exhibits.argument: Service can be suspended, so unlimited scans and access are not guaranteed.
